description: Calculates step response metrics from signal data: rise time, settling time, overshoot percentage, and steady-state error.

channel.description: Channel index of the Scope input to measure (default: 0)

link.description: BlockWerk share link (https://blockwerk.tech/?project=…) of the diagram, as returned by an earlier result. The connector rebuilds the diagram from it when it holds no diagram of its own.

stepTime.description: Time (s) the step is applied; settling time is counted from it (default: the stepTime of the diagram’s only Step block, else the moment the signal starts to move)

name: calculate_metrics
title: Calculate signal metrics
